name: San Carlos Convent
scope: San Carlos Borromeo’s mapped historic convent and attached San Lorenzo Mártir church as documented in January 2011. Includes the bell tower, three-bay plaster façade, linked convent ranges and four open courts. The adjacent battlefield, trees, museum interiors and neighboring independent sites are outside this asset.

originalReview.notes: The east front shows three rectangular doors under shallow blind arches, three arched upper openings, ochre mouldings, a central pediment and a tall square bell tower on the south.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit photographer public-domain dedications
review.notes: The exact published Qualla exterior was accepted with the original photographer’s dedication. The photographed church façade and tower date to the mid nineteenth century according to the national heritage record. Interior photos were set aside.
